verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Postman documents an official MCP server at postman.com/postman-mcp-server, which directly covers connecting an agent through a first-party MCP server. Postman is an API platform, not merely an agent, so this axis applies. The MCP Generator (build your own server from public APIs) and the Fabric gateway MCP registration are adjacent features and earn no extra credit. Missing for 10: documented setup and connection steps, tool coverage and auth details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.
